reviews.shade: Abib Pore Cleansing Oil Heartleaf Oil-Wash 200ml
reviews.text: I bought this cleansing oil after seeing one of my favorite YouTube creators use it in her skincare routine. It looked so nice that I decided to give it a try. My skin clogs very easily from cleansing oils, so I was honestly a bit nervous. I've tried products that claimed to be non-comedogenic before, but they still left me with clogged pores after just a few uses. So far, though, this one has been doing really well and I haven't noticed any problems. I'm also a big fan of Abib's Heartleaf line. I already use the cream, toner, and cleansing foam, and they've all worked great for my combination, sensitive skin. Hopefully this cleansing oil will be another product I end up loving too
reviews.zh: 我見到我最鍾意嘅 YouTuber 喺佢嘅護膚流程入面用緊呢支卸妝油，覺得睇落好好用，所以決定買嚟試吓。我嘅皮膚用卸妝油好容易閉塞，所以講真我都有啲擔心。之前試過一啲聲稱唔致粉刺嘅產品，但用咗幾次之後一樣令我毛孔閉塞。不過到目前為止，呢支表現真係好好，我未見到有咩問題。我亦都好鍾意 Abib 嘅魚腥草系列。我已經用緊佢哋嘅面霜、爽膚水同洗面奶，對我呢種混合性敏感肌嚟講效果都好好。希望呢支卸妝油都會成為我另一款心水產品。
